highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.156 update improves native path rasterization, glyph replay validation, and Graphite readback.
highlights_body: These same-milestone fixes leave managed wrappers, generated bindings, and package version inputs unchanged.

bullets.detail: Corrects Ganesh device-space path bounds and coverage-mask subset clamping, plus Graphite clip keys and wedge miter bounds. Convex antialiased rasterization also gains buffer-overflow and fixed-point arithmetic guards; those raster guards are disabled in custom builds defining SK_LEGACY_ALPHA_RUNS.

Validates serialized Slug positions, transforms, bounds, and flags, bounds direct-mask offsets, and preserves creation-time float rounding during replay. Unsuitable glyph data retains rendering fallbacks, including when glyph-atlas bilinear filtering is unavailable.
Corrects pixel-size and row-stride handling for GPU-to-CPU transfers from alpha textures to RGBx destinations, ensuring every destination pixel bit is written with opaque output.
